scope: Unhappy paths, recovery hints, motion and interaction targeting
boundary: Original source and pre-existing local Storybook build. This is not validation of the active Opus implementation or live providers.

observed.scenario: Account/Team Uncertain story at 390x844 after its fictional create-link interaction
observed.result: The form is disabled while the recovery status is above the viewport (top -122px) and Check saved state begins at -26px. Focus is on body.
observed.recovery: Reveal/focus the recovery message beside the initiating action. Preserve label and selected role.

observed.scenario: Voice Uncertain Charge fixture and source inspection of Open Usage/close
observed.result: The uncertainty state gates new requests, but Open Usage closes the session; close resets turns, receipts and uncertainty to EMPTY. Operation keys are generated at dispatch and not retained as a pending reference in session state.
observed.recovery: Keep affected text, selected context and credential-free operation reference while checking outcome; do not silently dispatch another charged request.

observed.result: The message instructs Reload to see the latest version but the button says Try again, leaving the action ambiguous.
observed.recovery: Name the actual recovery: Reload data, Review latest version, Check saved request or Play saved reply.

observed.result: HTTP 429 reaches the generic server-answered-status branch.
observed.recovery: Explain rate limiting and next action. Only show cooldown timing when supplied by the server. Preserve draft text.

observed.scenario: Voice Microphone Denied fixture target measurements at 390x844
observed.result: Close, recording and send buttons have 44px height; the standalone Session usage summary has only 21px height.
observed.recovery: Provide comfortable touch padding for standalone disclosure and context-removal targets without making inline text links into oversized controls.

positive_recovery_exercised.result: Recovered invitation link is visible. Invitations remains at two links (one initial invitation plus the single newly created invitation). One invitation-link field is rendered.
positive_recovery_exercised.boundary: Offline fictional adapter only; no real invitation, identity or external write.

additional_states_inspected: Microphone denied: typed input remains enabled and microphone retry is available; actual browser permission denial was not exercised
Playback blocked: captions remain and Play reply is available; source unit test specifies cached-audio replay without resynthesis, but was not executed in this review

recovery: Keep unsent text and selected references on failure; keep editing available while uncertain sends are gated
Distinguish failed reads, rejected writes, stale revisions and unconfirmed effects
Make the next recovery action visible beside its initiating control and announce state changes
Keep typed conversation usable when only speech is unavailable
Retain pending-operation identity across close/reopen and Usage navigation, scoped to the exact account/workspace
Mark stale/missing selected resources and allow refresh/remove without losing typed words
targeting: Explicit selection mode with count, selected names, keyboard actions and Escape to finish
Visible source highlight matches a stable ID/revision/range; never a reordered row index
Selection overlays never intercept nested controls or target content behind the companion/sheet
Context chips expose remove and return-to-source separately with comfortable touch targets
Return focus predictably after selection cancellation, chip removal or panel close
Do not move click targets during hover or background list refresh
motion: Use brief 150-220ms feedback for actual interaction/state changes, with static reduced-motion equivalents
Only actual microphone/playback levels drive meters; permission waiting, transcription, thinking and speaking have distinct text labels
Stop capture/playback immediately on stop/close; already-dispatched requests retain honest pending status
Keep content visible before transitions and avoid layout-shifting row entrances
Do not auto-scroll a conversation away from evidence the user is reviewing
No success animation before acknowledgement; no synthetic progress or confidence
